authority: User-directed Task detail bounded-summary and Task-scoped collection reconciliation, 2026-10-02. Focused refinement; no design pin advance.

relationship_summary.rule: Exact active direct Task-owned links only. Sum of kind counts equals exact_total. WFM owning RFC is separate identity context.

retry.bound: at most two immediate edges, schema unique predecessor/successor

TaskDetailV1_refinement.warning_codes: Deferred. Omitted from current attention summary; no authoritative empty warning array. Exact literals and complete classification remain owner reconciliation prerequisites for warning-dependent UI binding.

TaskAttentionListQueryV1.scope: pending owner evidence associated with exact Task; no stale/eligibility/warning inference

fields.exact_total: complete Task active relationship count, independent of cursor/page length
complete Task pending count for selected kind(s), independent of cursor/page length

fields.item_id: canonical UUIDv4 identifying review/proposal in its owning kind

TaskAttentionListItemV1.rule: Owner persisted evidence identity only; not current classification or actionable eligibility.

cursor.fingerprint: canonical SHA256 over version/query_id/sort_registry_id/null_order/task_id/kind; exact Task and kind scope required; page limit excluded

relationship.ordering: kind lexical ASC (device,rfc,sr), related_id ASC. Active exact pair is unique; no omitted tie breaker.

attention.ordering: kind lexical ASC (historical,regroup,source_terminal), order_utc ASC, item_id ASC. order_utc is created_at_utc for source_terminal and the literal 0 for historical/regroup; uses existing Task-scoped indexes.

consistency: Existence, exact totals and page rows share one LLD-01 ReadSnapshot per invocation. Continuation is live keyset paging, not a retained cross-request snapshot. No receipts/audit/revisions or owner mutations.

implementation.bounds: At most three*(limit+1) relationship/attention rows loaded. Constant number of SQL queries. Counts may traverse Task-scoped matching index entries; no global pending ID materialization or per-item owner detail calls.
implementation.schema: No migration/index change. Immutable runtime history preserved.

ui_binding: Pending owner warning enum and remaining exact full Task-detail transport closure; LLD-10 consumes only public owner contracts, never private tables.
